title: Buttons and button types
learningObjectives: Use buttons and button types accessibly and safely.

understand.concept: Buttons inside forms default to submit. Use type=button for non-submit actions and type=submit to submit.
understand.whyItMatters: Correct form structure improves usability, accessibility and data safety.
understand.analogy: Think of a well-labelled application form.
understand.analogyLimit: Browser checks alone do not make submitted data trustworthy; the server must validate it.

explain.narrative: Buttons inside forms default to submit. Use type=button for non-submit actions and type=submit to submit.

examples.explanation: Inspect labels, types and validation for each control.
examples.expectedOutput: The browser renders the form controls and provides native behaviour.

practise.guidedTask: Modify the example and operate every control using the keyboard.
practise.independentTask: Build an accessible registration form that respects privacy.

practice.starterCode:
<!doctype html>
<html lang="en"><head><meta charset="utf-8"><meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1"><title>Buttons and button types</title></head><body>
<form><button type="button">Preview</button><button type="submit">Send</button></form>
</body></html>
practice.resetCode:
<!doctype html>
<html lang="en"><head><meta charset="utf-8"><meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1"><title>Buttons and button types</title></head><body>

</body></html>
